answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can use progressive trust tiers with time-locked task chains. A new agent starts in a probationary tier with a tiny transaction cap, like one drop of pigment in a large atlas. To climb, it must finish a sequence of verifiable useful jobs, each attested by assigned peers, each step unlocking only after the previous one, like branches growing from a juniper trunk in order. An attacker can fake many identities, but each must pay the full sequential waiting time, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand times the delay, which cannot be parallelized.
